Main duties will centre around the yachts, the customers, and the base. Working hours vary and you MUST be able to cover operational requirements including early and evening shifts as required. The weekend are the busiest days at base and will be working days, days off will be scheduled mid-week.
Our exterior yacht cleaning teams play a vital role in our business. You will be a key driver in providing that “wow” factor when customers first step on board their vessel. It will be your responsibility to deliver superior cleaning excellence to ensure the outside of our yachts meet the standard that give our guests that exceptional first impression.
What You Will Be Doing
Carrying out a full clean of the yacht from the bridge deck to engine bays, including a rinse, soap wash, and chamois, followed by detailing of the yacht.
Ensuring the yachts are presentable to the highest standards set by the company, which will include;
Scrubbing the exterir of the yachts daily
Cleaning f shower curtains, rails, external cushions, and bilges.
Cleaning and detailing f all lockers (gas, anchor and water locker), cleaning inside and all rims and outside edges.
Cleaning and detailing f the helm station including winch handle pockets, cup holders and dorades
Buffing f the yachts
Cleaning all rubbing strakes and make sure all exhaust utlets are spotless
Reporting any defects noticed whilst cleaning to the technical manager
Utilizing chemicals in a safe and cost-effective way
Suggesting improvements for cleaning techniques
Any other reasonable duties as assigned by your line manager, including supporting with other departments, and cleaning of other areas.

Experience in a cleaning position is desirable
Comfortable moving around yachts confidently
A desire for excellence
Superior attention to detail
Self-motivated and able to show initiative
Takes pride in their work, and desire to excel in delivering yacht cleanliness to the highest standards
Able to work under pressure to deadlines
A team player that will assist others when required
A hard worker, who is reliable and professional
Dedicated to our guests and the guests experience
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
We believe people perform best when they can be their true selves, and diverse teams drive better results. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where everyone can succeed.

The selectee of this position works as a crewmember involved in the housekeeping, minor repair, and upkeep of government roads, parking lots, facilities, and buildings.

The selectee receives oral and written instructions from the Maintenance Mechanic Supervisor, or appointee, and is responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out the assigned duties and completing daily assigned work tasks. Operates and maintains light vehicles, to haul equipment, supplies and tools, or plow snow.

Selectee is responsible for custodial maintenance of visitor facilities, trash collection, and recycling. Duties may also include park housing maintenance including cleaning and seasonal use readiness.

This position may assist in minor repairs and maintenance duties of same locations including duties such as carpet cleaning, painting, tile floor waxing. This position may require heavy physical effort and stamina to assist with snow removal operations on sidewalks, parking lots, and visitor access locations using manual and mechanical methods.

Selectee will frequently lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, continually walking, bending, stooping, reaching, pulling and pushing. The work may be outdoors and may be in temperatures ranging from extreme cold (below zero) to warm (75F).

As needed, the selectee may also work as a flagman on road projects, pick up litter, load / unload supplies / furniture, assist with building maintenance and janitorial duties.

The selectee must be able to operate gasoline- or diesel-powered equipment including snow blowers, pickup truck plow, ATV plow, and/or skid steer loader after proper instruction and certification. An appointment to this position is restricted by law (5 U.S.C. 3310) to Veterans who are preference eligible if such applicants are available.

AREA INFORMATION: Wind Cave National Park is located in the southern Black Hills of southwest South Dakota. Climate extremes range from sub-zero temperatures during winter to over 100 degrees during summer.

Medical and dental services, schools K-12, shopping, and churches of most faiths are available in Hot Springs (12 miles) and Custer (20 miles). Housing for rent or purchase is available in Hot Springs and Custer. Rapid City, SD (pop:60,000) is one hour north of Hot Springs and has a full range of services available.

For more information about the Park visit our website: www.nps.gov/WICA.

The Housekeeping Aide - EVS Technician executes a full range of housekeeping activities in patient and non-patient care areas. The position may be assigned to any tour and may be required to work in various designated areas during any tour of duty.

Typically, the position works independently with general supervision, or works with a team and is responsible for the full-range of cleaning duties in an assigned area throughout the medical facility. These duties include, but are limited to the following: Performs floor maintenance, wall washing.

Cleans doors, doorframes, baseboard corners and edges, and stairwells. Tasks are accomplished by sweeping, dust mopping, damp and wet mopping, scrubbing, stripping, refinishing, buffing, vacuuming and extracting carpets and runners, spot cleaning areas, and high and low dusting.

Periodically utilizes pressure washers and heavy industrial powered and battery­ operated equipment the above task. Adjusts, cleans, and performs minor maintenance on this equipment and changes attachments for their proper use in achieving the best results. Empties trash and wastebaskets, replaces liners.

Transports general refuse, regulated medical waste and recycling to central collection areas.

Cleans rest rooms, bathrooms, and shower rooms, ensuring that they are cleaned and meet acceptable standards (cleans, disinfects, and deodorizes lavatories, showers, bathtubs, urinals, and toilet bowls; cleans mirrors, sinks, and water fountains; washes and polishes light and toilet fixtures).

Replenishes supplies of paper towels, toilet paper, hand sanitizers, and soap in all areas where dispensers are located. Moves and arranges furniture, patient wardrobes, beds, etc. in the assigned area to accomplish cleaning tasks.

Provides bed-making services in patient care areas and OD rooms; cleans mattresses, springs, and bed frames; and cleans bedside stands, over bed lights, blood pressure cuffs, bed tables, etc. in patient rooms; Removes bags of soiled textiles from patient rooms and transports to the designated soiled room in each ward area; Loads and unloads clean textiles from bulk carts.

Restocks clean textile closets, cabinets, shelves, carts, and participates in inventory management activities.

Defrosts and cleans patient care refrigerators and ice machines in nourishment kitchen areas; cleans stainless steel on storage instrument cabinets and counters, elevators in lobbies, wards, diet-kitchens and nurse utility rooms; and cleans ashtrays, smoke stands, sand urns in designated smoke areas and water fountains; Provides interim cleaning of windows and window ledges from the inside, cleans glass door and other glass surfaces; and replaces curtains and cleans blinds.

Cleans and/or replaces needle boxes. Periodically cleans specific non-critical Reusable Medical Equipment (RME) in inpatient and clinical areas of the medical center. Work Schedule: Permanent, Full Time positions, Sunday-Thursday, 11:00pm-7:30am. Shift will be discussed during the interview process.

What The Job Looks Like
We provide high-quality exterior cleaning services—like window cleaning, gutter cleaning, building washing, and pressure washing—to residential, strata, and commercial clients.

We aim for the kind of customer experience you’d expect at a Four Seasons hotel: polished, professional, and personal.

Want to be part of a tight-knit, values-driven team
Like working outdoors and being active
Take pride in doing a job well
Can communicate professionally with clients
Have a valid driver's license
Don’t mind a little extra attention (you’ll be wearing a kilt—we'll explain)
Who We Are
We get it—phrases like “family culture” and “work-life balance” are often empty. So don’t take our word for it—let us buy you a coffee and you can interview us . Ask the tough questions. If we’re not who we say we are, you’ll know.
We’re serious about our values. Come find out if we walk the talk.

Are you passionate about hospitality, quality, and creating an outstanding guest experience? Do you enjoy being hands\-on, building and coordinating teams, and making sure every apartment is perfectly prepared for our guests? Then this could be the right opportunity for you.

As Housekeeping Supervisor, you will take ownership of the housekeeping operations at one of our City Pop locations in Zurich.
This is a hands\-on leadership role combining team management, quality control, planning, inventory management, and daily operations.
You will help set up and manage our in\-house housekeeping team, from recruiting and onboarding staff to organizing schedules, equipment, supplies, and cleaning standards.
You will also work alongside the team when needed, particularly during busy periods and operational peaks.
Your goal is to build a reliable and efficient housekeeping operation that ensures consistent quality and an excellent guest experience.

Actively perform cleaning duties as part of the housekeeping team. This is a hands\-on role, and you will be regularly involved in cleaning apartments and common areas alongside your team, not only during staff shortages or peak periods.
Take ownership of the setup and daily organization of the housekeeping operation across our City Pop buildings.
Manage the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of the cleaning team, in coordination with HR, ensuring all employees are trained according to City Pop standards and procedures.
Prepare and manage the weekly cleaning schedules, considering occupancy, arrivals and departures, holidays, sick leave, and operational needs.
Act as the main point of contact for the cleaning team, supporting them with daily questions, operational issues, and priorities.
Ensure apartments and common areas are cleaned, inspected, and ready on time, carrying out regular quality controls and following up on any issues until resolution.
Set up and manage the housekeeping inventory, including the purchase of cleaning equipment and materials such as tools, chemicals, cloths, trolleys, and other required supplies.
Manage and replenish guest supplies handled by Housekeeping, including toilet paper, soaps, coffee, tea, and other amenities, ensuring sufficient stock is always available and properly organized on\-site.
Manage housekeeping supplies and purchases within the agreed budget, monitoring stock levels, consumption, and costs.
Organize deep cleanings, special cleanings, and apartment preparations, and ensure correct management of Lost \& Found.
Report technical defects or damages and coordinate with Operations, Facility Management, technicians, and other departments to ensure timely resolution.
Continuously review housekeeping processes and team performance, implementing improvements to increase quality, efficiency, and guest satisfaction.

At least 3 years of professional housekeeping experience, ideally in hotels, serviced apartments, or the hospitality industry.
Previous experience in a Housekeeping Supervisor or similar role is a strong advantage.
Experience in leading, training, and coordinating cleaning teams.
Strong knowledge of housekeeping standards, quality control, inventory, and daily cleaning operations.
A strong hands\-on mentality, with the willingness to work alongside the team when required.
Well organized, proactive, solution\-oriented, and able to manage priorities independently.
Strong attention to detail and excellent guest and service orientation.
Minimum B2 level in both German and English; additional languages are an advantage.
Comfortable using digital tools and operational systems.
Reliable, flexible, and stress\-resistant, with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.
Valid work permit

At City Pop, you will join a dynamic and international environment where you can take real ownership of your area.

We are looking for someone who leads by example, takes ownership, and makes sure things get done.

Learn more about CBP's mission, core values and careers at https://www.cbp.gov/about Joining the Customs and Border Protection Office of Field Operations will allow you to use your specialized skills that result in the proper care and feeding of Customs and Border Protection owned dogs.

Apply for this exciting opportunity to strengthen the Department's ability to perform homeland security functions by performing duties requiring application of specialized knowledge of procedures, techniques, regulations, and information. This position starts at an hourly rate of $27.53 (WG-06, Step 1) to $32.13 (WG-06, Step 5).

In this position, you will become a key member of a team of Homeland Security professionals concerned with the day-to-day care of Customs and Border Protection owned dogs. Typical work assignments include: Cleaning dog kennels, which includes hosing, sweeping, scrubbing and removing dog stools, unconsumed food and other refuse.

Maintaining canine status charts. Feeding and watering all canines in feed pans, including measurement and preparation of food items and diets. Handling both trained and untrained canines with varying temperaments. Observing the appearance and activity of canines for signs of illness, injuries, disease, and discontent.

Administering prescribed medications to canines on a timely basis as recommended by the veterinarian.
NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Although a specific length of time and experience is not required for most trade and labor occupations, you must show through experience and training that you possess the quality level of knowledge and skill necessary to perform the duties of the position at the level for which you are applying.

Qualification requirements emphasis is on quality of experience, not necessarily the length of time. To minimally qualify for the WG-6 grade level you must meet the Screen Out Element: Ability To Do The Work Of The Position Without More Than Normal Supervision.

To meet the screen out element, you should have experience performing the following duties: Maintaining kennels such as repairing damaged and unsafe houses, fencing, gates, and hoses, and replacing water buckets.

Maintaining canine status charts for accountability, documenting canine movement with regards to kennel placement and control, food, stool, weight, and medications. Observing the appearance and activity of canines for signs of illness, injuries, disease, and discontent and watching for signs of injury or changes in physical condition.

Measuring and preparing food items to meet veterinarian prescribed diets and performing food and medication distribution in canine kennels at designated times and documents appropriately.

### **Your Purpose** ###
As the Assistant Housekeeping Manager aboard our luxury cruise line, your purpose is to support the daily operations of the Housekeeping Department, ensuring that every area of the ship meets our high standards of cleanliness and service.

Working alongside the Housekeeping Manager, you will assist in overseeing the cleanliness of guest rooms, public spaces, and crew areas, ensuring they are meticulously maintained to provide a superior guest experience.

You will play a vital role in maintaining smooth operations, helping to guide and support the housekeeping team to achieve excellence in service and cleanliness, and ensuring the comfort and satisfaction of our Guests and Crew.

In this key role, your impact will be felt throughout the ship. By assisting in managing the housekeeping team and ensuring cleanliness standards are consistently met, you will directly contribute to the safety, comfort, and satisfaction of our Guests.

Your proactive approach will help maintain operational efficiency, ensuring all areas are in top condition at all times. Your efforts will ensure the seamless functioning of the Housekeeping Department, helping to create a pristine environment that enhances the overall cruise experience for our Guests.

Your support will also have a lasting impact on the reputation of our cruise line as a provider of top-tier hospitality services.

**Sie sorgen dafür, dass bei uns alles läuft - wir sorgen dafür, dass Ihre Arbeit Wirkung zeigt.**
Die Berufsfachschule Winterthur ist ein lebendiger Arbeits- und Lernort mit rund 3800 Lernenden und über 200 Lehrpersonen. Damit sich unsere Lernenden und Mitarbeitenden in unseren fünf Schulgebäuden wohlfühlen und der Schulbetrieb reibungslos funktioniert, braucht es Menschen, die anpacken, mitdenken und den Überblick behalten.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per **01.02.2027** eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Hausmeister mit eidg. Fachausweis Hauswart/in
### Ihre Aufgabe - vielseitig, verantwortungsvoll und mitten im Schulbetrieb ###
Als Teil unseres Teams tragen Sie wesentlich dazu bei, dass unsere Gebäude und Anlagen jederzeit sicher, funktionstüchtig und gut unterhalten sind. Sie übernehmen vielseitige Unterhalts- und Werterhaltungsarbeiten in unseren fünf Schulgebäuden sowie im Aussen-bereich und stellen gemeinsam mit dem Team den täglichen operativen Betrieb sicher.
Dabei sind Sie nicht nur für den fachgerechten Gebäudeunterhalt zuständig, sondern übernehmen auch Kontroll-, Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten, kümmern sich um die fachgerechte Entsorgung, die Lagerbewirtschaftung und unterstützen bei unterschiedlichen internen Dienstleistungen. Auch bei besonderen Situationen können wir auf Sie zählen: Sie leisten Winterdienst, achten auf Unfallverhütung, Sicherheit und leisten Erste Hilfe.
Ein weiterer wichtiger Bestandteil Ihrer Tätigkeit ist die Begleitung und Förderung von Lernenden als Praxisbildner/in. Sie geben Ihr Fachwissen gerne weiter und tragen damit zur Ausbildung der nächsten Generation von Berufsleuten bei.
Als engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit unterstützen Sie zudem die hauswirtschaftliche Betriebsleitung und übernehmen bei Bedarf deren Stellvertretung. Die Bereitschaft zu Früh- und Spätdiensten sowie zu Pikettdiensten (Nacht, Wochenende und Feiertagen) gehört ebenfalls zu dieser abwechslungsreichen Funktion.
### Das bringen Sie mit ###
Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachfrau/Fachmann Betriebsunterhalt EFZ oder über eine handwerkliche bzw. technische Berufslehre mit EFZ. Idealerweise besitzen Sie den eidgenössischen Fachausweis als Hauswart/in oder sind bereit, diesen innerhalb der nächsten zwei Jahre zu erwerben.

Ergänzend bringen Sie die Ausbildung als Berufsbildner/in und die Qualifikation als Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r für Brandschutz (GVZ SiBe) mit. Eine Nothelferausbildung inklusive Reanimationskurs sowie den Führerausweis der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus.
Für diese verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe verfügen Sie über mindestens drei Jahre Berufs- und Führungserfahrung. Erfahrung in einem Schulbetrieb ist von Vorteil.
Persönlich überzeugen Sie durch Ihre zuverlässige, selbständige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise. Sie packen gerne an, arbeiten exakt und speditiv und behalten auch in hektischen Situationen den Überblick. Gleichzeitig sind Sie hilfsbereit, kommunikativ, teamfähig und flexibel. Sie haben Freude daran, sich weiterzuentwickeln und sind bereit, sich entsprechend den Anforderungen der Schule weiterzubilden.
Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Bereitschaft zu Früh- und Spätdiensten und zu Pikettdiensten runden Ihr Profil ab
### Das bieten wir Ihnen ###
Bei uns erwartet Sie mehr als «Gebäude unterhalten». Sie arbeiten in einem abwechslungsreichen und lebendigen Umfeld, in dem kein Tag ganz gleich ist. Ihre Arbeit schafft die Grundlage dafür, dass rund 3800 Lernende und zahlreiche Mitarbeitende ihren Schulalltag in einer sicheren, funktionierenden und angenehmen Umgebung gestalten können.
Sie übernehmen eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeiten in einem motivierten Team und stehen in engem Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Bereichen unserer Schule. Dabei können Sie Ihre fachlichen Kompetenzen einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und gleichzeitig Ihr Wissen weitergeben.
An der BFS Winterthur pflegen wir eine Kultur, in der Wertschätzung, Sorgfalt und Offenheit einen wichtigen Stellenwert haben. Wir begegnen einander respektvoll, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und sind offen für neue Ideen und Entwicklungen. Gemeinsam mit Ihnen möchten wir diese Kultur weiter pflegen und entwickeln.
Wir legen Wert auf eine gute Zusammenarbeit und eine Arbeitsumgebung, in der Eigeninitiative, Engagement und gegenseitige Unterstützung geschätzt werden. Gleichzeitig bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und sich entsprechend den Anforderungen der Schule weiterzubilden.
Die Anstellungsbedingungen richten sich nach den kantonalen Vorgaben und bieten Ihnen die attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Kantons Zürich.
